_comment: Local dataset manifest. Footage itself is NOT committed to git (local only) — this file tracks what exists locally so dataset composition is reproducible/inspectable from the repo alone. `clips` holds actual source footage currently present on disk (mixed `frozen_eval` and `dev` roles — see `role` per entry and `_roles` below). `planned_acquisitions` holds not-yet-captured footage specs. `generated_artifacts` holds pipeline outputs that were incidentally left inside this directory tree — never geometry/restoration inputs. Mechanical fields (width/height/fps/codec/frame_count/duration_seconds) were (re)computed via ffprobe; frame_count/duration_seconds for the original Week 1 entries were previously cross-checked against LOG.md via cv2.VideoCapture and are unchanged. `width`/`height` are encoded/container dimensions; `decoded_width`/`decoded_height` are the array shape cv2.VideoCapture actually returns for that clip (rotation side-data can make these differ — see `portrait_decode` tag and per-clip notes). `capture_time`/`capture_time_source` mean plausible acquisition/camera capture time only, following the precedence: embedded container creation_time > filename timestamp > filesystem birth time > filesystem mtime (last resort). When no step in that precedence is trustworthy (e.g. an embedded creation_time that is obviously a re-encode/export timestamp, not a dive date), `capture_time`/`capture_time_source` are left null rather than populated from a weaker signal; the best available filesystem clue, if any, is instead kept separately as `file_time`/`file_time_source` and must never be read as capture time.
_tags_note: Per-clip `tags` (artificial_light, ambient_light, dynamic_subject, geometry_rich, rigid_scene, low_texture, portrait_decode, etc.) are heuristic, visually-inferred dataset-triage metadata from sparse frame sampling and path/filename evidence — coarse selection aids for Week 3 method screening, not measured geometry results, ground truth, or a substitute for actually running a method on a clip.

generated_artifacts.notes: Generated artifact (gray-world `uw correct` output on MURKYSHARK.MP4), not source footage — listed for completeness but intentionally excluded from source-clip enumeration, frame-count/duration bookkeeping, and any geometry input selection. Has no embedded creation_time (re-encoded). width/height above are the decoded/output array shape (portrait), not a capture property. Should not be treated as a frozen test set input; regenerate rather than hand-edit if it goes stale. Also flags a standing invariant-7 concern: a generated output currently lives inside data/testset/ alongside source footage rather than a separate output path — worth relocating when convenient, not done here since this task must not move/rename footage.

planned_acquisitions.notes: Empty as of 2026-08-22 — no chart/reference footage captured yet. This is the blocking item for the Week 1 gate (delta_e cannot be wired into `uw score`, and chart_refs.json patch regions cannot be measured, until a chart clip exists here).

Week 3 controlled geometry clip (C1): rigid textured reef/rock/wreck, deliberate lateral or arc camera motion for real triangulation baseline, diffuse ambient light, NO dive-light sweep, minimal moving animals/vegetation, limited particulate, 20-40 s. CONDITIONAL as of this update, not a hard prerequisite: acquire only if the existing wreck_*/cenote_*/swimthrough_* dev footage turns out to be insufficient to diagnose geometry because of inadequate parallax/scene conditions. Purpose-built for geometry diagnosis if needed -- separating bad parallax from bad camera physics from bad matching from bad scale is otherwise hard with footage captured for restoration/temporal evaluation.

Week 3 scale/calibration clip (C2): same scene family as week3_geometry, plus the colour chart at >=3 MEASURED camera-to-chart distances spanning near/mid/far and >=3 positions in the frame, a rigid known-length scale bar, and enough constraint on the target-plane pose to derive the distance to each reference corner individually (one scalar stand-off is NOT per-pixel range truth). Underwater checkerboard at 2-3 measured distances if practical -- that is what produces residual-vs-(image radius, range) evidence for the refraction test. Also record in-air GoPro intrinsic calibration at the same resolution/FOV/Protune settings. CONDITIONAL as of this update, not a hard prerequisite: required only if competing geometry methods disagree materially in spatial shape, or if later work needs defensible metric/physical scale.

OPTIONAL, diagnostic only. Week 3 difficult clip (C3): low-texture sand or smooth panel, some fish/vegetation, normal swim speed, plus an artificial-light pass. Used ONLY to fire conditional challengers and to seed Week 6B. Never used to select the primary geometry method, and never a replacement for week3_geometry.

PLANNED, not yet captured, needed only at Week 6B. L1 ambient/diffuse control (light off); L2 controlled artificial light (rigidly mounted torch, ambient minimal, same scene points observed under different beam incidence AND at varying camera-to-scene distance -- distance variation is a hard identifiability precondition); L3 mixed ambient+artificial if practical. Calibration: measured camera-to-light rigid offset, chart at >=3 ranges x >=3 frame positions with light on, white/grey planar target sweep (~30-40 frames, varied range and angle, fiducials at corners), a few seconds of open water for the pure-water backscatter bound, and a repeat of the white-target sweep at start and end of dive to test beam-calibration transfer across battery state. L4 (the difficult real clip) is the EXISTING lights/LIGHTNIGHTDIVE.MP4 -- stress only, never the fitting set.

_roles.role_field: Per-clip `role` in `clips` is now the primary source of truth: `frozen_eval` (distance_shot, light_night_dive, murky_eel, murky_shark, swimthrough_01 -- the Week 1 / Phase 2A / Phase 2B clips whose results are already part of the project record) vs `dev` (everything else currently on disk: cenote_*, reef/open_water encounter clips (murkyisheel2, murky_shark_2, murky_tuna, sealion, turtle, whaleshark, murky_dolphin -- categories corrected on cleanup review, see per-clip notes), swimthrough_02/03, wreck_* -- available for inspection and method selection during Week 3, not yet part of any frozen result).
_roles.note: Adding dev footage or this structured metadata does not alter any existing clip, metric, or frozen Phase 2A/2B result. A frozen_eval clip's role does not change just because it lives in a directory also used for dev footage (e.g. murky/).
